claim: Raspberry Pi forum (2025-01-09..14): Pi 5 on 6.13.0-rc PREEMPT_RT (16k and 4k-page builds), cyclictest -m -p 90/95 under 'stress -m 4 ... -c 4': per-thread maxima 196-458 us, spikes to 800 us, an overnight run above 1000 us; linux-rt-users discussion pointed to memory-bus contention; no Raspberry Pi staff fix in the locked thread [source: community forum]

NVIDIA forum (2026-08-26): two AGX Orin modules on JetPack 6.2 / L4T 36.4.3 PREEMPT_RT with isolcpus/nohz_full/rcu_nocbs on cores 8-11 give ~10 us vs 50-90+ us worst case on the same test; NVIDIA (DaneLLL): 'The deviation between the two modules are huge. This not not expected'; no root cause or fix posted [source: community forum]

eProsima Fast-DDS #2624 (2022): two containers with --network=host exchange no data because Fast DDS derives the same host ID and assumes SHM; maintainer recommends --ipc=host (or sharing /dev/shm, or disabling SHM); closed as duplicate of #1698/#1750/#1755

NVIDIA Isaac ROS forum (2025-05-04/08): after OTA from L4T 36.3 to 36.4 the Isaac ROS dev container fails to mount libnvidia-eglcore.so.540.3.0; moderator: Isaac ROS 3.1 is not compatible with L4T 36.4.3 (JetPack 6.2), use 3.2 - the container is coupled to the host BSP/driver version [source: community forum]

NVIDIA forum (2024-06-14..08-08): on Jetson AGX Orin with containerd (no Docker), GPU containers fail ('NvRmMemInitNvmap failed with Permission denied', nvml error); NVIDIA: nvidia-container-cli no longer supported on iGPU Jetson; working path = CDI spec with nvidia-ctk cdi generate --mode=csv, runtime mode=cdi, device plugin 0.16.1, and manual node label nvidia.com/gpu.present=true because GPU feature discovery does not detect Jetson [source: community forum]

NVIDIA/NemoClaw #404 (2026-03-19, closed 2026-04-13 without a code fix): on Jetson Orin Nano Super (JetPack 6.x, kernel 5.15.148-tegra) k3s's network policy controller panics after 'iptables v1.8.10 (nf_tables): RULE_INSERT failed'; reporter attributes it to the Tegra kernel lacking nft_chain_filter modules; nvidia-smi reports memory.total [N/A] so GPU detection returns null

k3s requirements: 'etcd is write intensive; SD cards and eMMC cannot handle the IO load' (external SSD recommended on Raspberry Pi); server minimum 2 cores / 2 GB RAM; Raspberry Pi OS 'may suffer from a known iptables bug' and needs cgroup_memory=1 cgroup_enable=memory

systemd #32946 (2024-05): Ubuntu 24.04, systemd 255.4, signed UKI, LUKS enrolled with --tpm2-public-key; adding a KEK certificate broke TPM unlock because systemd-cryptenroll also adds a literal PCR policy for --tpm2-pcrs, which silently defaults to PCR 7; closed via PR #32993 (PCR bank selection when literal binding is off)

fwupd #7939 (2024-10-21..2025-02-07): a UEFI dbx update via fwupdmgr changed PCR 7 and forced a BitLocker recovery prompt; contributors confirm firmware measures db/dbx into PCR 7 per the TCG PC Client spec; fixed by flagging dbx updates as affecting full-disk encryption (PR #8033, commit 515e8ce)

rugix/rugix default-branch tree (2026-11-10): has a systemd-boot boot flow (LoaderEntryDefault/LoaderEntryOneShot via bootctl), systemd-boot partition schemas and LUKS2/TPM test recipes, but no file mentions dm-verity or UKI; issue #117 (rugix-ctrl could not find the active slot when root is a dm-crypt mapper) was closed 2026-07-22 by commit c0de80c
